notablePrerequisites: Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Omen Hawker to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Omen Hawker triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat from step 2.
